body:
I took 20MG of Zolpidem and 1.5 MG of Xanax.
It's now been about 2 hours since taking all the above.
Other than feeling very slightly drowsy, I feel no euphoric effectss like I used to feel off of just 1 5mg Zolpidem.
This sucks!  lol
Where's my euphoria I learned to look forward to and love so much?!
